items.source: The application is not expected to catch or inspect this exception, and should allow it to propagate.
items.translation: 应用程序不应捕获或检查此异常，而应允许其传播。

items.source:
Internal state has been set that ensures that the transaction will act appropriately (including rolling back and
retrying if necessary) regardless of what the application does with this exception.
items.translation: 内部状态已设置，以确保无论应用程序如何处理此异常，事务都能采取适当的行动（包括在必要时回滚并重试）。

items.source: An opaque signal that something went wrong during the execution of an operation inside a transaction.
items.translation: 表示事务内部操作执行过程中出现错误的不可见信号。
